input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives an express conformance-to-Specifications warranty for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and continuing for as long as the Software is under Maintenance Services — this meets and in fact exceeds the preferred 12-month software warranty. A real remedy exists: Garman must repair non-conforming Software at no additional charge under the Software Repair Service (p0077), and during acceptance testing Sparkling may reject the Software and recover "any and all amounts paid to Garman hereunder" (p0053, p0057). There is no "AS IS" language and no disclaimer of implied warranties anywhere in the agreement, so nothing swallows the express warranty; the Section 15 liability cap preserves recovery of direct damages. Minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording are noted but not flagged: there is no separate professional-and-workmanlike services warranty covering installation, training and maintenance, no no-malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and post-acceptance repair is qualified by "best efforts" without an express replace-or-refund alternative. These are drafting refinements we may raise conversationally rather than material failures.
